hypothesis: The linked maintenance image's private DMA admission and cache adapter and USB task handle mapped pages, request bounds, a 32 KiB streamed response and final-IN progress.
conclusion: Software composition only, not physical DMA coherence, USB throughput or recovery.
narrative: checks/storage-maintenance-dma.py (removed as a model of the linked maintenance image covered by a733-storage-maintenance) executed the image's private DMA admission/cache adapter and USB task with modeled provider and transport edges. It checked every mapped page, supplied-pointer refusal, both incoming request bounds, a 32 KiB streamed response and final-IN progress publication; the host parser consumed the native-produced frame. The companion selection checks/a733-storage-update.py --dma-only runs a 67-sector DMA backup in batches of 64 and three, followed by 67 one-sector PIO writes with DMA readback, and checks cache failure, transport loss and deadline retention and the eight-sector PIO stride.

hypothesis: The supply profiles, native C write-admission guards and USB framing/provider guards admit and refuse as designed.
conclusion: Host passes only; physical recovery and board behavior are unqualified.
narrative: checks/a733-storage-native.py (removed, superseded by a733-storage-update) covered the supply profiles, native C write-admission guards and USB framing/provider guards. It modeled CPU privilege, task ownership, register access and completed USB preparation, and compiled the original AArch64 adapter and native task units; it did not execute bootstrap or establish physical recovery. The full host backup, update and restoration workload was reused from the connected batch. The additive cases passed under AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: native1 holds the successful PMIC and MMC guard checks; native2 holds the successful USB guard check and four original AArch64 compilations. The USB fixture used aborting stubs for unexecuted task entry points retained by sanitizer metadata. The merged PMIC source includes the display supply profile alongside the two USB supply profiles. The connected core/host batch (batch1) passed under the same sanitizers with eight streaming SHA-256 boundary vectors matching the host reference; the affected native units and existing embedding fixtures compiled and their old protocol workloads were not rerun. Native task, mutex, USB and watchdog execution are outside the result.
